title: A Parallel Analytical Legalization Algorithm via Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers
problem: Legalization with cell overlap resolution typically relies on suboptimal heuristic cell-by-cell search, while analytical methods suffer from runtime overhead and discrete problem complexity.
motivation: Large-scale design legalization requires better solution quality without excessive runtime overhead.
method: Parallel analytical legalization using Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with heterogeneous CPU-GPU parallelism to handle the discrete nature of placement legalization.
key_novelty: Parallel analytical formulation of legalization problem via ADMM with CPU-GPU heterogeneous acceleration.
contributions: Significantly improved solution quality vs existing legalizers

metrics.other: legalization quality: better than existing methods

limitations: No specific performance metrics provided; evaluation limited to unnamed open-source tools.
primary_theme: Analytical ADMM-based legalization with GPU parallelism
